openHouse.title: SPRING Open House at RabbitEARS
openHouse.description: We’re excited to host our Spring Open House. This is a wonderful opportunity to showcase our residents and help more people discover what RabbitEARS is all about. Please spread the word! We’ll be sending out an email soon that you can forward.
openHouse.volunteerHelpTitle: Volunteer Help Needed for the Open House
openHouse.volunteerHelpText: We’ll need helping hands throughout the day — please sign up via the Calendly links below:

shifts.description: Regular rabbit & guinea pig cage cleaning and event setup
Greeters, crowd monitors, and bunny ambassadors to interact with visitors
Cleanup and returning habitats to normal positions

reminders: 📅 Save the date: Saturday 4/25 Open House! We’ll need cleaning help from 10 AM – 1 PM that day.
Reminder: please give apple twigs to the rabbits — they make great, healthy chewing snacks!
introHtml:
Hi RabbitEARS Volunteers,

Thank you for all the care and dedication you continue to give to our rabbits and guinea pigs. Your time and effort truly make a difference in their lives.
